sections.Profile:
Fish Tales, released by Williams in October 1992, is a four-player solid-state game with a dot-matrix display in which players catch fish and exaggerate how large they are. Designed by Mark Ritchie with art by Pat McMahon, it launches the ball with a fishing-rod plunger and locks balls in a rotating fishing-reel mechanism.
